domain: Education & Learning Sciences (item response theory and test equating)

distractor_reasons.teacher_implementation_survey_spring2026: teachers' spring 2026 self-reports of how they used the platform; the outcomes guarantee is settled on students' assessed achievement and the professional learning hours on the sessions delivered, so no figure reads the survey
distractor_reasons.renewal_forecast_2026_27.xlsx: Partnerships' 2026-27 renewal stages, probabilities and forecast revenue; the credits are settled on the 2025-26 order forms and applied to the invoices actually raised

forward_dated_files.billing_invoices_2026_27.csv: the 2026-27 invoice register of 20 November 2026 carries its invoices' due dates and service periods, which run past the register date by design
forward_dated_files.order_forms_2025_26.xlsx: subscription terms end on 30 June or 31 July 2026, before the setting

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task482/generator); Lumenfold Learning, the Lumenfold Science Outcomes Assessment, Caldrith Assessment Partners, the 58 partner districts and their places, the students, identifiers, accounts, invoices and every record and number in the files are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the item response model (two-parameter logistic), the latent regression population model and plausible values follow the published methodology of large-scale assessment (Mislevy, 1991; Rubin, 1987); the states' prior-test performance level names follow each state's public assessment reporting; roster codes follow common state student information system conventions
